title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Protection skill warns of suspected social engineering
summary: The briefing accurately reports the automatic Protection skill, its warning options and the conflicting roadmap and Message Center schedules. The Facilitator licensing, admin path and availability command are supported; Protection-specific controls and warning details remain undocumented in the sources checked.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the Protection skill.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Protection skill social engineering settings licensing warnings retention transcript processing; opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams and purview/ai-teams-facilitator. Neither describes Protection.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described where the Protection-specific transcript analysis runs.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Protection skill social engineering settings licensing warnings retention transcript processing; Facilitator Protection restrict information sharing processing warnings retention. Opened Facilitator setup and Purview Facilitator pages; no Protection-specific processing location.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether Protection warnings are retained.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Protection restrict information sharing processing warnings retention. Opened purview/ai-teams-facilitator and Facilitator setup; read Teams retention excerpt. General AI-interaction retention is documented, but Protection warnings are not identified as stored interactions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described what the Protection warning's temporary information-sharing restriction changes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Protection restrict information sharing processing warnings retention; opened Facilitator setup and Purview Facilitator pages. The roadmap and MC1536056 name the option without describing its mechanism; no further description found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: Before rollout

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Neither the roadmap item nor MC1536056 names a setting for the Protection skill itself.
claims.quote: No action is required to enable the Protection skill. ... Review the Facilitator documentation to familiarize yourself with the feature.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The effect of blocking the Facilitator app on the Protection skill specifically has not been stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Protection skill settings PowerShell MicrosoftTeams Graph block; opened Facilitator setup and Update-M365TeamsApp. App blocking is documented, but neither source names Protection or specifies its response to blocking.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Allow or Block controls Facilitator app availability.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.quote: PS C:\> Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -AppAssignmentType Everyone ... Updates the availability value for Bookings app ... to Everyone.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table
